sources.entry: Kaset - Native YouTube Music client for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sozercan/kaset) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Kaset - Native macOS client for YouTube Music and YouTube, built with Swift and SwiftUI.

summary.one_liner: Kaset is an unofficial native macOS client for YouTube Music and YouTube, built with Swift and SwiftUI.
summary.what_it_does: Kaset plays YouTube Music content, including DRM-protected tracks, using an existing Premium subscription, and also offers a YouTube mode for recommendations, search, subscriptions, Shorts, history, comments, and video playback with captions, quality selection, and picture in picture. Playback features include a 6-band parametric equalizer applied to WebKit output, plain and synced lyrics, queue management, a "Smart Shuffle" that blends suggested tracks into the queue, background audio, and track notifications. The library section covers playlists, liked songs, and podcasts, with playlist creation and editing, plus Explore, Search, and History. On macOS it integrates with Control Center Now Playing, media keys, the Dock menu, the share sheet, keyboard shortcuts, and AppleScript, and it exposes a kaset:// URL scheme and Shortcuts/Siri/Spotlight actions. It can also load WebKit Web Extensions such as uBlock Origin Lite and SponsorBlock.
use_cases: listen to YouTube Music on a Mac
play YouTube videos in a native macOS app
control music playback from Control Center or media keys
automate playback with AppleScript, Raycast, or Alfred
browse and manage YouTube Music playlists
watch YouTube with picture in picture
how_to_run: Or download the .dmg from the latest release page and drag Kaset into Applications
If macOS blocks the app, allow it via System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway, or run: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Kaset.app
notable: Full playback of DRM-protected YouTube Music content via a Premium subscription
Smart Shuffle blends suggested tracks into the queue based on what is playing
Loads WebKit Web Extensions such as uBlock Origin Lite and SponsorBlock
kaset://play?v=VIDEO_ID URL scheme and Shortcuts, Siri, and Spotlight actions
caveats: Requires macOS 15.4 or later; Apple Intelligence features need macOS 26.0 or later
Not signed or notarized by Apple, so macOS Gatekeeper warnings must be bypassed on first launch
Unofficial app, not affiliated with YouTube or Google; a Google account is needed for personalization
